faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: RindaNet is designed for lawful privacy and secure access. Always follow local laws and regulations.
faq.q2: Will it slow down my internet?
faq.a2: RindaNet uses smart routing and optimized protocol selection to minimize speed impact.
faq.q3: Can I use one account on multiple devices?
faq.a3: Yes. Pro and Enterprise plans support multi-device usage with centralized management.
faq.q4: Do you keep user activity logs?
faq.a4: No. Our infrastructure is built around a strict no-logs approach.
